score_notes.preaching: Liturgical preaching from the 1928 BCP lectionary, in the prayer-book Anglican tradition.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Vestry leadership is male; men's ministries common in ACC parishes.
score_notes.mission: ACC has a presence on six continents and nearly two dozen countries.

churches.denomination_detail: APCK — Continuing Anglican jurisdiction (NOT ACNA). APCK was formed in 1977 from the Congress of St. Louis as part of the broader Continuing Anglican movement rejecting Episcopal Church innovations (women's ordination, 1979 BCP). DC parish in Georgetown.

score_notes.christology: Orthodox per Continuing Anglican standards (1928 BCP, 39 Articles, Affirmation of St. Louis)
score_notes.gender: GREEN: APCK does NOT ordain women to any clerical office; rejected the Episcopal Church's 1976 women's ordination decision. Strict male-only priesthood + episcopate.
score_notes.leadership: Archbishop + diocesan bishops + male priests + vestry (traditional Anglican polity)
score_notes.cultural: GREEN: APCK was founded specifically to preserve traditional Anglican faith and practice against modernist drift; consistently traditional on sexual ethics
score_notes.denominational: APCK confessional accountability — traditional Anglican strict

churches.assessment: The Anglican Parish of Christ the King at 2727 O Street NW in Georgetown DC is the see church of the Anglican Province of Christ the King (APCK), led by The Most Rev. Blair W. Schultz as Archbishop and Rector. APCK is one of the Continuing Anglican jurisdictions formed in 1977 from the Congress of St. Louis — rejecting the Episcopal Church's women's ordination, 1979 prayer book, and other modernist novelties. APCK does not ordain women; uses 1928 BCP. Theologically the most traditional Anglican option in DC.
churches.gender_detail: No women clergy per APCK polity (strictest Anglican standard)
